spans.s: AT0157 केशपतन keśapatana Falling of hair which is a sign of (imminent) death of poisoned patient.
SV0129 केशप्रसादन keśaprasādana One among the daily regimen, combing is good for hairs; it removes dust, louse and dirt. Maintains hygiene of head.
SR0211 केशभूमिः keśabhūmiḥ Field of hairs. Field of hairs
RS0106 केशयन्त्र keśayantra An apparatus resembling the filter prepared out of the hairs useful for filtration
AT0158 केशशात् keśaśāt A bad prognostic condition in the patient of snake bite where the hair come off the body, even on the slightest pull.
DG0118 केश्य keśya 1. Beneficial for the hair. 2. Synonym of Krishnagaru(Aqualaria agollacha) & Bhringaraja (Eclipta alba)
